passages.text:
# Archival transcript
Written September 30, 1849.
The east depot reported
receiving the alder memorandum
sent by Arun Moss in response
to the request of September 27,
1849.
Inventory leaf 1. The archive cupboard held a woolen cover beside an unrelated register. No dispatch is recorded here.

# Archival transcript
Written September 30, 1849.
In response to that request of
September 27, 1849, I, Arun
Moss, sent the alder memorandum
to the east depot.
